en.title: Rust encodes packaged Android resource chunks
en.body: The shared native library encodes the player's 64 KiB chunks into padded Base64. Built-in arm64 NEON preserves the vector path. Existing JavaScript and Android consumers keep the same bytes, exceptions and resource lifecycle.

zh.title: Android 包内资源分块由 Rust 编码
zh.body: 共享原生库负责将播放器的 64 KiB 分块编码为带填充的 Base64，arm64 继续使用 NEON。现有 JavaScript 与 Android 调用方保留原有字节、异常和资源生命周期。
